ボラティリティターゲティング

A portfolio management technique in which asset weights are dynamically adjusted to achieve a specified target volatility, improving risk control across varying market conditions.

Definition

A portfolio management technique in which asset weights are dynamically adjusted to achieve a specified target volatility, improving risk control across varying market conditions.

Operational example

Volatility targeting allows asset managers to maintain consistent risk levels, reducing drawdowns during periods of increased market turbulence.
